This Imagineer turned his office into a pirate tavern | Open Office Hours
Steve, an Imagineer from the Dimensional Design Department, gives us a tour of his pirate-themed office! From pickle pirate monkeys to Star Wars maquettes, there’s lots of (literal) treasure to see.
